notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.content:
Update list: 

1. The main innovation was the improvement of artificial intelligence, now zombies will not just run at the player when you appear, and patrol the area and attack if the player enters the field of view. 
2. Altars have been added to the game, next to them you can find weapons. 
3. The speed of zombies has been significantly reduced, now you can run away from them, the number of health has been increased. 
4. Correction of detected bugs and errors. 
5. Turkish was added to the game. 

Your team Zombies In The Forest

notes.title: Discounts in honor of the release!
notes.content:
Hello! 

Here we go! On behalf of all the developers, we thank our dear players who have helped and are helping us to make our game better and better every day. We also understand that it is very difficult to release a completely new project to the masses.

Therefore, in honor of the launch, we decided to make an incredible discount of 40% in order to allow as many people as possible to try out our product.

Your team Zombies In The Forest

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Before the release of our game are a few days!

Of course updates before release are intended primarily for polishing the finished product. And we have something to brag about:
1) After deep optimization, we managed to increase the level of performance on different configurations by 15-35%. In our opinion, this is an impressive result!
2) Various small bugs and defects that caused discomfort during the game were fixed.
3) Seriously improved physics and animation quality

Thank you to all who support us and follow our game, you are very important to us

Your team Zombies in The Forest

notes.title: The first version of Localization!
notes.content:
Our team is working hard on the game, adding new features and improving gameplay.

During the regular discussions, we thought that releasing the game only in one language, at least not beautiful in relation to players around the world.

Therefore, in addition to English, we decided to add a few more languages so that players from other countries could enjoy Zombies in the Forest in their native language!

Namely:
German
Russian
Spanish
Italian
French
Polish
Chinese
Japanese

Please note that this is the first rather rough version of localization, in the future the quality of translation will significantly increase, and other languages will be added to these.

Your team Zombies in The Forest
